options.name: access_zone
options.description: This option mentions the zone in which the user/group exists. For a non-system access zone, the path relative to the non-system Access Zone's base directory has to be given. For a system access zone, the absolute path has to be given.

options.name: api_password
options.description: the password of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the quota. Maximum length is 1024 characters.

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to force creation of a quota on the root of /ifs.

options.name: group_name
options.description: The name of the group for which quota operations will be performed.

options.name: labels
options.description: A string of labels for the quota, comma-separated. Maximum length is 1024 characters.

options.name: onefs_host
options.description: IP address or FQDN of the PowerScale cluster.

options.name: path
options.description: The path on which the quota will be imposed. For system access zone, the path is absolute. For all other access zones, the path is a relative path from the base of the access zone.

options.name: port_no
options.description: Port number of the PowerScale cluster.It defaults to 8080 if not specified.

options.name: provider_type
options.description: This option defines the type which is used to authenticate the user/group. If the I(provider_type) is 'ads' then the domain name of the Active Directory Server has to be mentioned in the I(user_name). The format for the I(user_name) should be 'DOMAIN_NAME\user_name' or "DOMAIN_NAME\\user_name". This option acts as a filter for all operations except creation.

options.name: quota_type
options.description: The type of quota which will be imposed on the path.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the Smart Quota should exist or not. C(present) - indicates that the Smart Quota should exist on the system. C(absent) - indicates that the Smart Quota should not exist on the system.

options.name: user_name
options.description: The name of the user account for which quota operations will be performed.

options.name: verify_ssl
options.description: boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
